text:
emily.r: Quick heads-up — I wanted to request an accommodation for frequent visual migraines and photophobia. Bright slide decks, flashing UI demos, and high-contrast animation in product demos can trigger severe headaches and nausea. I can do meetings but need a few adjustments.

joel.mgr: Thanks for raising this, Emily. Totally want to support. What specific changes would help you during demos and meetings?

emily.r: Helpful things: 1) presenters avoid autoplaying animations or flashing transitions, 2) provide slide PDFs with dark-mode friendly color scheme beforehand, 3) give me the option to sit off-camera or step away briefly if a flare starts, 4) when showing product, use static screenshots or low-framerate screen shares. I can also provide a short note from my clinician if needed.

karen.hr: This is absolutely an accommodation we can handle. If you're comfortable, please submit the ADA intake form (optional for interim measures). We can start an interim plan while docs are pending.

li.dev: From product demos POV we can make a quick checklist for presenters: disable animations, use high-contrast accessible theme, and attach static screenshots. We can also record a low-motion version for people who need it. Happy to help implement.

emily.r: That checklist would be great. Also asking that meeting hosts add a line in invites: "If you need low-motion materials or a dark-mode PDF, contact the presenter."

joel.mgr: I can update recurring team meetings and our demo protocol. For customer-facing demos, we may need to coordinate with sales/design so we don't surprise customers.

karen.hr: Interim plan suggestion: 1) enable low-motion and dark-mode materials for internal recurring meetings immediately, 2) presenters asked to share slide PDFs 24 hours prior, 3) Emily allowed to take short breaks or sit off-camera, 4) 14-day check-in. We'll open a confidential case for tracking.

hr-bot: Case created: HR-8388 - "visual sensitivity accommodation: low-motion slides + dark PDFs (Emily R)". Intake received 1834509800. Assigned: karen.hr.

li.dev: I'll add a PR to our demo-playbook repo with a "low-motion" section and a small script to render slides in a dark theme for PDFs. Example snippet: ```slides --theme dark --no-animations --export=pdf```

emily.r: Wonderful — that CLI flag looks perfect. Also, for external recordings, can we ask product marketing to keep run-time animations optional? They often auto-loop.

joel.mgr: Will do. Team, let's respect this as confidential and share only with folks on the case. Emily, would you be okay with me adding a line to our team meeting invites about low-motion materials?

emily.r: Yes please. Small ask: if a flare happens, I might need someone to note action items so I can catch up later.

karen.hr: Noted. Interim accommodation to include: meeting notes assigned when Emily steps out, 14/30-day check-ins, and confidentiality clause. I'll post the written interim plan here by EOD and request signatures from Emily and Joel.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: added "low-motion" slide guidance and dark-theme export option.

li.dev: PR opened: docs/demo-playbook#42 with instructions and the CLI example.

emily.r: Thank you everyone. I really appreciate the quick, reasonable adjustments. I'll submit the intake tonight and attach a brief clinician note when available.

karen.hr: Case HR-8388 created and assigned. We'll follow up with the interim plan draft in-thread. Confidentiality reminder: share details only with stakeholders. :lock:
